Problem Statement:
Write a program to find the maximum product of any two numbers in an array. 
Input Description:
1. First line: An integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) – number of elements.
2. Second line: n space-separated integers (-10^6 ≤ ai ≤ 10^6). 
Output Description:
Print the maximum product. 
Sample Input:
5
1 10 -5 2 -20 
Sample Output:
100
